text:
Ghrazi Blood Knights Duo 100% Ranged-Melee Hybrid  

​
Introduction
This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in #unknown-channel.
​
Positioning

⬥ Starting from the tile you spawn on when you enter the instance, use  +  to reach the tile marked above.
⬥ Karmina tank forwards target cycle.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will get moved west or east of Karmina, it doesn't matter which way you get moved.
⬥ Vasily tank backwards target cycle.
⬥ You can use this Tilemarkers plugin preset to display the lure tile ingame.
